newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: KLASCO RELOADINGS RECORD HIGH IN MARCH.
newsitem.headline: KLASCO RELOADINGS RECORD HIGH IN MARCH.

text.p: Lithuania's biggest stevedoring company KLASCO said on Wedneday it reloaded in March 160,082 tonnes of cargoes more than a previous month.
"In March the work was very intense and we reloaded 889,292 tonnes of cargoes versus 729,200 tonnes a month before," finance director Algirdas Kateiva told Reuters.
"Last month we reloaded a record high volume of cargoes since 1990," Kateiva added.
"The cargo in March was dominated by metals, sugar, fertilisers and frozen fish," Kateiva said.
Kateiva said that in March 1996 the company reloaded 676,500 tonnes of cargoes.
He added that during the first quarter of 1997, KLASCO reloaded 2.29 million tonnes of cargoes.
KLASCO is a 90 percent state run company and the right wing country's government plans to privatise it in an open bid.
The government said last week that a privatisation bid to draw a privatisation plan for the company might be announced in April.
